name: ignis/temporal-core-transport
description: Runs temporalio/sdk-php on Temporal's own sdk-core instead of RoadRunner: a HostConnectionInterface and a CodecInterface that translate sdk-core workflow activations to sdk-php's command model. Host-agnostic — it needs an activation source, not a particular runtime. Written to be offered upstream. Includes the client half: sdk-php's WorkflowClient over a host-supplied unary call, with no gRPC extension.
